name: Sakae (Chiba, Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Sakae town emblem in white: an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character with a crown-like top.
history: Municipal flag of Sakae, a town in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 April 1956.

features.role: Sakae town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a stylised character with a crown-like top
